reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding) and function has live non-test callers. Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json contains no trust_assumptions table; no lookup match possible. Gate 3: contracts/protocol/sources/entry_points/admin/emode.move is explicitly in_scope. Spec deviation is clear: create_emode_params_inner (L175) checks collateral_factor_bps < BPS_DENOMINATOR but never > 0; an admin holding AdminCap can pass collateral_factor_bps=0 with liquidation_factor_bps>0 (satisfying the strict < check), producing a valid NewEMode with zero collateral weight. Users whose emode positions use that asset have their health-factor contribution drop to zero, rendering them immediately liquidatable. Verdict is CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY because the attack path requires a privileged AdminCap holder rather than a permissionless external attacker. Severity held at Medium: admin misconfiguration causes direct user-fund loss via forced liquidation, but relies on a trusted role.
